answer: A mechanism that actually bites: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because cedar only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, ocean is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any sable approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
